rationale: Class 2 row-validation issue. The bundle reports five PRIVATE_CREDIT rows with blank interest_rate and basis_spread. Raw source table 15 has exactly five rows after the debt total under Equity Investments / Preferred Equity. Their spread cells are NA and their interest cells are either preferred-equity PIK rates or NA. The source therefore does not support treating these as private-credit debt rows requiring SOFR spread/rate extraction; the defect is classification/lookthrough of preferred equity into the private-credit rate rule scope.
